g.text: ResQ-Vision / 04 IMU contacts and front steering
PROVISIONAL CANDIDATES - confirm class hardware before wiring
Native module symbols / named nets / no PCB footprints / Rev P1 / 2026-10-19
IMU candidate uses 3.3V VIN and onboard I2C pull-ups; default address 0x6A. Other IMUs may differ.
CONTACT_FRONT/REAR each need an external 10k pull-up to 3V3_LOGIC (R1/R2 in pin matrix and sheet 05).
NC contact proposal: open contact/cable reads HIGH and requests a local stop; a short-to-GND is undetected.
U6 shifts steering PWM from 3.3V to 5V. HS-422 takes 4.8-6.0V; 800mA stall is a vendor figure.
Servo torque, linkage/limits, startup movement and feedback are unverified. No turn-in-place or cliff sensing.
